raw_response:
I am 58 this year, been farming these 10 mu since I was 18. My old man taught me, and now I plant cotton because that's what this land is good for — I tried wheat and corn before but cotton pays better if the bugs don't ruin it.

This year I will plant guoxinmian, same as my neighbor Lao Wang. He had good luck with it last year. I need about 25 jin of seed for the whole plot, that's 2.5 jin per mu. I sow in late April when the soil warms up.

For fertilizer, I always put down one full bag — 100 jin — of compound fertilizer per mu before planting. The dealer sells me the cotton formula, it's 16-16-16. That's 50 kilos per mu. Then when the cotton flowers in July, I topdress with half a bag of urea, about 50 jin per mu. You can't starve cotton of nitrogen when it's making bolls. I know some people say that's too much, but I'd rather waste fertilizer than lose yield. A bad year means I lose real money.

I rotary till the land first — costs me 50 yuan per mu. My well is good, so I irrigate three times: once after sowing to get the seedlings up, once at flowering, and once when the bolls are filling. Border irrigation, flood the furrows.

Pesticide is the big headache. Cotton gets aphids, bollworms, mites. I spray every 7-10 days during summer, that's at least 13 times total. I buy the spray from the agro-shop, same as last year. I also need to hire 3-4 people for pruning and topping when the plants get too tall — my wife and I can't do 10 mu alone.

I expect about 550 jin per mu this year if the weather holds. Last year I got around 500 jin, but the rain was bad. This year looks normal so far.
